# ikd-Tree

ikd-Tree is an incremental k-d tree for robotic applications.

## Vendored copy

- Source: https://github.com/hku-mars/ikd-Tree
- Commit: `e2e3f4e9d3b95a9e66b1ba83dc98d4a05ed8a3c4`
- License: [GPLv2](http://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html)

`ikd_Tree.h` and `ikd_Tree.cpp` at that commit live in `include/ikd_tree/` and `src/`;
`CMakeLists.txt` and `package.xml` wrap them into a ROS2 ament package.
